evals.prompt: This HTML slide deck only prints the currently visible slide. Add browser print-to-PDF support so every slide prints on its own landscape page and the controls are hidden.
evals.expected_output: Print CSS reveals all slides, sets landscape zero-margin pages, hides controls with page-specific selectors, and includes a verification checklist.

evals.prompt: Make this static HTML report printable as an A4 PDF. It has sticky navigation, scrollable sections, and dark mode styles.
evals.expected_output: Print CSS uses A4 portrait margins, hides navigation, prevents scroll clipping, handles color adjustment or print-specific colors, and verifies the PDF output.

evals.prompt: Add a PDF button to this dashboard, but keep the printed output focused on the data tables and charts.
evals.expected_output: Adds a no-print button wired to window.print(), hides dashboard controls in print, preserves wide layout in landscape, and avoids hiding printable button-like content too broadly.
